app.title: Exoplanet Hunter Dashboard
app.summary: A person opens a dashboard of transit signals that a trained classifier has already scored, and reads headline counts and test-set accuracy scores first. They filter the signals by true class, by train or test split, or to the model's mistakes only, then pick one signal. For that signal they see its probability gauge, the true label beside the prediction, its orbital parameters, and its folded light curve in a full-orbit view and a zoomed transit view. In a second tab they judge the model as a whole from a precision–recall curve, a confusion matrix at a decision threshold they set, and score histograms by class. They can then download the full scored table as a CSV.

task.text: Check a trained classifier's planet-versus-false-signal predictions, both one signal at a time and across the held-out test set, at a chosen decision threshold.

data.text: A table of transit signals, each with a true label, orbital period, transit duration, depth, model score and split, plus two fixed-length folded light curves per signal (a global view and a local view).
data.item: a candidate transit signal on one star, with its model score and its folded light curves

stage.text: checking a trained classifier's scores on held-out data, after training and before reporting

mechanism.text: Sidebar filters narrow the scored signals to a selector. The chosen signal drives a gauge, an info panel and two folded light-curve charts. A separate tab summarises test-set performance, and its confusion matrix is recomputed whenever the threshold slider moves.

field.text: deep-learning classification of transit light curves in astronomy

workflow.name: evaluate a classifier's predictions item by item and in aggregate

steps.here: Precomputed scores and folded curves are read from results.csv and curves.npz in a data folder. A topbar and KPI cards then show how many signals were analysed, the class counts, and the test PR-AUC and ROC-AUC.

steps.step: filter to the items that matter
steps.here: Sidebar radios pick the true class (all, planets, false signals) and the split (test, train, all), and a checkbox keeps only the signals the model got wrong at the 0.5 cut.
A selectbox of KOI names opens one signal. A gauge shows its planet probability against a 50% line, and badges set the ground truth beside the prediction, with period, transit duration and star ID.
The signal's phase-folded light curve is drawn twice side by side, as a full-orbit global view and a zoomed local view of the transit, in normalised flux against bin position.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: The Performance tab draws the precision–recall curve on the test set, a confusion matrix recomputed at the threshold set on a slider, and overlaid score histograms for planets and false signals.
The Data tab lists every scored signal with the score shown as a progress bar, and a button downloads results.csv.

distinctive: Each item has two views of the same signal at different scales, the whole orbit and a zoom on the transit, matching the two inputs the model was trained on.
A filter keeps only the model's errors, so false positives and missed planets can be inspected one by one.
The decision threshold is a slider, so the confusion matrix shows the trade-off at any cut, while the headline PR-AUC and ROC-AUC do not depend on a threshold.
A train/test split field lets the person keep the held-out evaluation apart from the training signals.

parts.title: Overview KPIs
parts.summary: Loads the scored signals and shows the total count, class counts, and test-set PR-AUC and ROC-AUC as headline numbers.

parts.title: Signal filters
parts.summary: Narrows the signals by true class and by data split, or to the model's errors only, and warns when nothing matches.

parts.title: Signal analysis
parts.summary: Lets the person pick one filtered signal by name and shows everything about it: score, truth, prediction, parameters and curves.

parts.title: Probability gauge and signal info
parts.summary: Shows the model's planet probability on a gauge with a 50% threshold, and sets ground truth and prediction badges beside the period, duration and star ID.

parts.title: Global and local light curves
parts.summary: Draws the selected signal's phase-folded light curve side by side, as the full orbit and as a zoom on the transit.

parts.title: Model performance
parts.summary: Summarises the test set with a precision–recall curve and overlaid score histograms for the two true classes.

parts.title: Confusion matrix with threshold slider
parts.summary: Recomputes the test-set confusion matrix at whatever decision threshold the person sets on a slider.

parts.title: Scored signals table
parts.summary: Lists every signal with its parameters and its score as a progress bar, and downloads the table as a CSV.
